output.tldr: IRCTC exhibits steady revenue growth and a clean balance sheet, but persistent margin compression, volatile operating profitability, and heavy regulatory/pricing dependence weigh on long-term conviction.

promises.promise: Targeting to achieve 15% sustainable growth this year.
promises.actual: FY26 full year revenue reached record Rs. 5,215 crores, achieving ~15% growth.
promises.why: FY26 annual revenue matched guided growth targets.

promises.promise: We will maintain 30% EBITDA margin overall.
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 OPM at 28% and Q2 FY27 at 31%.
promises.why: Margins fluctuate near the 30% target despite historical compression.

promises.promise: Submit proposal application for acquiring final payment aggregator license by end of January.
promises.actual: Management advanced RBI license process across subsequent quarters.
promises.why: License application milestones were actively pursued as guided.

promises.promise: Catering revenue growth will continue to maintain around 15%.
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 catering revenue grew 33.82% YoY.
promises.why: Actual catering growth outpaced the guided 15% run rate.

promises.promise: Tourism revenue growth should continue to be around 20%.
promises.why: Tourism segment consistently delivered ~20% growth matching expectations.

promises.promise: We will try to maintain catering margins between 10% to 12%.
promises.actual: Traditional catering brackets preserved within guided parameters.
promises.why: Catering operating thresholds remained stable as guided.

credibility.line: Management generally delivers on revenue and segment growth targets, though margin volatility and structural pricing pressures persist.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: we will maintain 30% EBITDA margin overall.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Operating margins dropped to 27% in Q4 FY26 and 28% in Q1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Catering segment recorded revenue of Rs. 2,399 crores, registering 12.89% growth.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Catering is the largest segment at 46.4% of FY26 revenue driving topline expansion.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Total revenue reached INR1,370 crores, up 18.1% year-on-year for the quarter.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FIN reports Q1 FY27 revenue at 1370.0 crores with 18.1% YoY growth.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Profit after tax stood sustainably at INR330 crores for the quarter.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: FIN reports Q2 FY27 PAT dropped 22.8% YoY to 264.0 crores.

bull.point: Virtually debt-free balance sheet provides financial resilience.
Dominant market share in reserved ticketing provides a wide economic moat.
bull.evidence: Command 89% share of reserved railway tickets.

bull.point: Strong secular growth in high-margin tourism and catering segments.
bull.evidence: Tourism revenue reached Rs. 150 crores, up 20.97%.

bear.point: Secular downward trend in operating profit margins over recent years.
bear.evidence: Operating margin compressed 4.0 pts in 3 years (36% → 32%).

bear.point: Sluggish growth in convenience fee revenue despite passenger volume increases.
bear.evidence: Internet ticketing revenue stood at INR361 crores, up about 0.5%.

bear.point: Working capital deterioration and lengthening cash conversion cycle.

watch_next: Trajectory of operating margins and stabilization of PAT growth.
Progress on RBI payment aggregator license and iPay scaling.
Impact of Swiggy and Zomato integrations on onboard catering.
